reason: Compared all four changed engine sources with this exact baseline. Technical digest reconciliation does not validate local agricultural calibration, tariffs, market prices or scientific assumptions.
limitations: Valid-output equivalence preserves existing behavior; it does not establish that existing reference data are accurate or fresh.
